characters.summary: Imhotep is an ancient Egyptian high priest resurrected through forbidden rituals. He wields supernatural control over sand, plagues, and the undead, growing stronger with every sacrifice.

mechanisms: Regeneration from sand and bodily restoration
Immunity to conventional weapons when in mummified or partially restored form

weaknesses: Vulnerable to the Book of Amun-Ra and specific magical artifacts
Loss of immortality if stripped of his regeneration in human form
limitations: Bound by ancient rituals and magical artifacts that can strip his power

sources.supports: Imhotep's origin, powers, sand manipulation, and resurrection mechanics

feats.claim: Created a massive sentient sandstorm shaped like his face that engulfed Cairo.

notableResults.note: Defeated when stripped of his immortality by the Book of Amun-Ra.

conditional.dependsOn: Being in incomplete or undead mummy state

campaignTags.claim: Wields ancient Egyptian curses and dark resurrection magic.
Rebuilds his body by consuming human victims.

unknowns: Exact boundaries of his plague creation outside of desert environments

characters.summary: Iosef Tarasov is a spoiled, reckless Russian mob heir. Accustomed to absolute protection by his father's syndicate, he relies on hired muscle rather than disciplined personal combat.
weaknesses: Arrogant, cowardly under pressure, and lacks elite martial training
Relies entirely on his father's syndicate protection
limitations: Poor combat discipline and easily panicked when cornered

sources.supports: Iosef Tarasov background, role as mob heir, and encounter with John Wick

feats.claim: Broke into John Wick's home with armed accomplices and stole his car.

notableResults.note: Tracked down and killed by John Wick at his fortified safehouse.

unknowns: Any independent combat feats outside of armed protection squads

characters.summary: Jen Yu is a gifted young noblewoman secretly trained in elite Wudang martial arts. She possesses extraordinary agility, sword mastery, and wire-fu acrobatics.
limitations: Standard human physical durability without internal energy cultivation defenses
